summary: Restore manual gantry jogging in the droplet imager while preserving strict motion safety validation.
notes: Camera-derived image-plane moves now return integer X, Y and Z displacements. Stationary Y is integer zero, so arrow and Ctrl+arrow requests pass the existing integer motion contract.

Preserves X/Z rounding, firmware motion quantization, focus shortcuts, travel bounds, collision checks, command ordering and queue-rejection behavior. The shared conversion also serves nozzle dataset capture and pixel-to-machine positioning.

Regression tests check exact output types and real shortcut-to-controller paths in both imaging windows, including X/Y/Z jogging, odd and sub-quantum requests, invalid values, bounds/collisions and first-command queue failure.

The attended LC-001 operator confirmed imager jogging works on c0ba0e972aa95837b407008c30fea63424d9432a. Normal exit, protected postflight, exact released-firmware restoration and SAFE 30/30 passed. This is operator-reported physical verification, not a new motion accuracy or timing measurement.

Firmware artifact bytes, protocol, runtime dependencies, machine-data schema, execution-calibration version 4 and execution-data compatibility capabilities are identical to v1.3.2. No firmware flash is required solely for this application update; existing provenance and SAFE requirements remain enforced.

Retains the three exact stable legacy migration cohorts and the pinned rc.11 release-candidate discovery route. Legacy deployment retains its guarded migration, firmware/recovery verification and attended canary requirements.

Automatic rollback remains unconfigured. Preserve calibration measurements, committed counts, progress and immutable revisions; use protected current-version or exactly qualified compatible-bundle recovery.
See docs/v1.3.3_release_qualification.md for scope, evidence and publication order. Existing large-optimizer and long-session timing limitations remain unchanged.
